title: Modeled reduction in the busiest shard load
method: Synthetic initial loads are 500,500,500 and 2,500 requests/s. Moving an independent 1,500-request/s tenant to a fifth shard leaves 500,500,500,1,000,1,500. Maximum drops 40%; no latency or uniform-capacity claim is implied.
alt: Modeled reduction in the busiest shard load. Original mean: 1000 requests per second; Original busiest: 2500 requests per second; New busiest: 1500 requests per second. Illustrative values.
